observation.command:
docker exec zammad-devcontainer-devcontainer-1 bash -lc '
cd /tmp
rm -f cj.txt
# GET root page, capture cookies and csrf meta token
HTML=$(curl -s --max-time 60 -c cj.txt http://127.0.0.1:3000/)
CSRF=$(echo "$HTML" | grep -o "name=\"csrf-token\" content=\"[^\"]*\"" | sed "s/.*content=\"\([^\"]*\)\".*/\1/")
echo "CSRF_TOKEN_LEN=${#CSRF}"
curl -s --max-time 60 -b cj.txt -c cj.txt -X POST http://127.0.0.1:3000/api/v1/signin \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -H "X-CSRF-Token: $CSRF" \
  -d "{\"login\":\"admin@example.com\",\"password\":\"test\"}" \
  -o /tmp/signin.json -w "LOGIN_HTTP=%{http_code}\n"
echo "--- response (first 600 chars) ---"
head -c 600 /tmp/signin.json
echo
'
